statement: Native ARM64 Dolphin 2503 on merged W8 code enumerates and connects the MP-only virtual Remote with caller EEPROM and imported synthetic MP/Nunchuk blocks. It reports mode 4 and reads 32 MP calibration bytes successfully in two chunks. An additional bounded mapping-view observation shows changing A, accelerometer preview, two basic IR points and gyro indicator. Explicit bindings and a zero UI gyro auto-calibration period are lab settings; rate accuracy, physical compatibility and game acceptance are not established.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded virtual-host observation; mapping UI changes only where explicitly observed. No physical calibration, rate accuracy, audio, radio, game or whole-controller promotion.
